title: GPM: Meet the Team: Jay Parker
description: This is a series of short profiles that showcase the systems engineers and designers who helped develop, build, and test the Global Precipitation Measurement (GPM) Core Observatory spacecraft.
keywords: GPM, Spacecraft, Japan, Testing, Engineers, Earth, JAXA
via: the NASA Image and Video Library

transcript.text: Well as the lead mechanical, I'm responsible for the design and fabrication of the structure
We're also responsible for all the mechanical ground support equipment that's used to lift
and move the spacecraft throughout the facility and ground support equipment that the spacecraft
resides in when it's journey from Goddard to Japan.
Well throughout the design there's various challenges.
One noteworthy one was to basically integrate the prop system which has most of its components
and fuel tank at the bottom end of the spacecraft but also the four components, the four thrusters
at the top of the spacecraft which the way the fuel lines are all welded together they
wanted to integrate all that as a single unit.
